name: Crystal Lake
summary: At Crystal Lake, murlocs claim the shore east of Goldshire. Their attacks endanger villagers and travelers passing by.

sections.title: A Troubled Shore
sections.body: East of Goldshire, Crystal Lake lies within walking distance of the Lion's Pride Inn. Freshwater murlocs claim its shore and shallow shoals, attacking anyone who comes too close. William Pestle, an alchemist at the inn, hires travelers to drive them back and gather the crystal kelp they carry for his experiments.

faq.answer: Crystal Lake lies east of Goldshire in central Elwynn Forest, just past the village outskirts.

faq.q: Why are murlocs gathered at Crystal Lake?
faq.answer: Freshwater murlocs nest and forage at Crystal Lake. Their numbers near Goldshire have grown as Stormwind's local guard struggles to protect the area.

faq.q: What do adventurers need from Crystal Lake?
faq.answer: William Pestle, an apothecary at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, hires travelers to slay murlocs along the shore and gather crystal kelp for an invisibility potion.

angles.text: Crystal Kelp grows in the lake's freshwater shallows. Most of it comes from resident murlocs, who gather it from the lake bed.
The murlocs near Goldshire show how stretched the kingdom's military is in protecting its core territories.
